text:
Ayesha (product): Quick sync — need a clear launch checklist for the enterprise compliance pilot (Acme Bank). Main asks: audit log export, per-tenant retention windows, BYOK/KMS handshake, and SOC2 evidence packaging. Can we scope an MVP that’s deployable in Q3?
Liam (eng-runtime): High level ok. Need to know retention tiers (default vs override) and if we must support instant export for legal hold. Those change ingestion/archival paths.
Gina (security): SOC2 needs immutable audit streams + tamper-evident proof for exports. For BYOK we need KMS attestation + rotation policy documented. Also: retention > 1 year triggers additional review.
Marcus (ops): Cost note — keeping hot logs for 90 days vs 7 years cold-archival is very different. Can we split into: 90d hot, 2yr warm, 7yr cold? Also need lifecycle S3 buckets + lifecycle rules.
Rana (legal): Acme requires EU data residency and e-discovery: export format must include chain-of-custody metadata and a legal-hold flag that prevents deletion even if retention elapsed.
Jules (customer-success): For pilot we should offer an onboarding checklist and an automated evidence export sample so Acme can validate. Also prepare a one-pager on SLA and expected delivery times.
Liam (eng-runtime): Proposed minimal config snippet for per-tenant retention + hold:
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "acme-bank",
  "retention": {
    "default_days": 90,
    "overrides": [
      {"name": "warm", "days": 730},
      {"name": "cold", "days": 2555}
    ],
    "legal_hold": false
  }
}
```
Liam (eng-runtime): Implementation notes — ingestion writes to hot topic with prefix caching; archival job moves to cold with merkle checkpoint. Need 2 infra tickets: multi-zone archival replicate + legal-hold immutability flag.
Gina (security): Add requirement: signed merkle root + timestamped KMS sigs on export. BYOK handshake must log the key thumbprint and consent ack.
Rana (legal): Confirmed — export must contain thumbprint, signed manifest, employee id of approver, and retention policy version.
Marcus (ops): I ran a cost sketch: 1TB/mo hot -> $X, 1TB cold -> $Y. We should include cost-to-customer estimates per retention lane in pilot docs.
Ayesha (product): Draft launch criteria suggestion:
- [ ] MVP supports per-tenant retention overrides up to 7y
- [ ] Legal-hold flag prevents deletions and is surfaced in Console and API
- [ ] Export format: gz + manifest + merkle proof + KMS sigs
- [ ] BYOK handshake flow + key-thumbprint audit recorded
- [ ] SOC2 mapping doc updated for audit stream immutability
- [ ] Pilot onboarding checklist + cost estimate for Acme
Liam (eng-runtime): Timeline: can spike + 2 sprints for infra + security hooks if we soft-limit scope (no multi-region replication day 1).
Gina (security): I'll own the security acceptance criteria and review. Need design review by Wed.
Jules (customer-success): I'll prepare the onboarding and sample export template. Need product copy by Fri.
Rana (legal): I'll sign off on export fields; flag any jurisdictional blocks.
deploy-bot: <deploy-bot> acl-checks passed for infra spike branch (CI #1423) :white_check_mark:
Ayesha (product): Next steps — Liam to open infra + api tickets, Gina & Rana to define acceptance fields, Jules to draft onboarding. Sync tomorrow 11am. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Marcus (ops): Opening cost ticket and a small runbook for archival restore times (important for SLAs). Will link to tickets.
Liam (eng-runtime): Filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/2234 (archival lifecycle), https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/7890 (legal-hold API).
Ayesha (product): Perfect. If we can lock the acceptance checklist by EOD tomorrow we can include the pilot in the Q3 release plan.
Jules (customer-success): Noted — I'll loop Acme for a final confirmation of retention lanes and EU residency requirement.
Gina (security): Heads-up: anything that extends retention beyond 2 years will need an additional privacy review (GDPR DPO). I'll coordinate.
Rana (legal): Also confirm export delivery SLA: do we expect synchronous export or an async package within 24h? Acme prefers async and verifiable artifacts.
Ayesha (product): Let's aim for async export within 24h for MVP. We'll document latency expectations. Meeting invite sent for 11am sync.
